title: CraftSquad Configuration
description: Role-to-engine/model/effort bindings for a CraftSquad agent team. Subagents and rules never reference models; they are resolved from this file on every dispatch.

defaultReasoningEffort.description: Effort for roles not covered by a more specific rule.

geminiDefaultReasoningEffort.description: Effort for roles running on the gemini engine.

timeoutSeconds.description: Default per-dispatch timeout (in seconds, default: 900 for 15 minutes).

engineDefaults.description: Model used by squad_set_role when no model is given.

roles.description: Role definitions. Known role ids get autocompletion; custom ids are allowed.

engine.description: gemini = executed by the host agent; codex/claude = local CLI; cli = deterministic command.

model.description: Model id passed to the engine.

command.description: Command to run when engine is cli.
